## First observation from the common-Pyomo scaling campaign

The first returned h300 W STO pilot uses Gurobi 13.0.3 through Pyomo/APPSI,
one solver thread and seed 42. Its configuration retains the 28,800 s native
allowance, 1% relative-gap target, automatic presolve and method selection,
and the numerical tolerances specified in Appendix C. The original solution
passed independent primal and cost validation. The companion HiGHS calculation
has no terminal collection at the reporting cutoff.

| Solver / threads / repetition | Collection | Objective, BRL trillion | Common gap, % | Native runtime, min | Application end-to-end, min | Sampled worker-tree peak, GiB |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| Gurobi / 1 / 1 | Validated, target met | 9.289109 | 0.004105 | 48.229 | 91.794 | 74.535 |
| HiGHS / 1 / 1 | Not yet terminal | — | — | — | — | — |

: First h300 observations under the new common-Pyomo protocol. Unavailable
HiGHS values are not zero or a failure. {#tbl-scaling-h300-pilot}

The Gurobi lower bound is 9.288727295144 trillion BRL. The ordered Pyomo
algebra contains 25,107,544 variables, including 392 binaries, 1,056,962 linear
constraints and 94,967,766 nonzeros. Its fingerprint identifies the algebra
before native presolve; comparison with the companion solver requires that
solver's own retained input, matrix and bound-policy identities.

The optimizer processed one node and 3,355,126 LP iterations. Although the
native time allowance was eight hours, it returned after 2,893.71 s with the
stopping criterion satisfied. Application end-to-end time is 5,507.64 s;
model construction, transfer, matrix identification and extraction contribute
additional effort, with some timing regions enclosing others. These clocks
must not be added as disjoint components. The sampled 74.535 GiB worker-tree
peak is below the declared 192 GiB allocation, but sampling does not certify
an instantaneous maximum or production isolation.

The financial subtotal is 385.502 billion BRL, while artificial penalties
represent 95.850% of the penalized objective. Expected domestic service is
91.326%, with 58.787 million t of unmet demand. Expected static exceedance is
46.444 million tonne-periods, and reception overflow is 33.839 million t.
Stock exposure accumulated over periods and reception overflow have different
dimensions and are not added as installed emergency capacity.

The [original source-bound observation and local integrity audit](https://github.com/unb-lamfo-or-ai-hpc/model-agrologistic/blob/8c836ecc6d6fb41768884541bdb98b0085421af4/docs/evidence/paired_pyomo_h300_gurobi_2231228_review.json)
retain the objective, bound, input identities, parameter values, original
validation and timing definitions. This is one observation in the new protocol,
not an additional repetition of the earlier native-Gurobi h300 sequence.
Until the companion result and later repetitions are available, it supports
an attainable-scale observation rather than a paired solver ranking or
statistical estimate of parallel performance.
